def: NVIDIA's inference stack: TensorRT compiles trained models into optimized engines for NVIDIA GPUs, and TensorRT-LLM is its open-source library for serving large language models.
practice: Often the fastest option on NVIDIA hardware but NVIDIA-only; TensorRT engines are by default tied to the GPU type and TensorRT version they were built with, while TensorRT-LLM is now architected on PyTorch (as of November 2026).
